name: Honda Mayumi
source:
[b]An Instructor With a Scary Smile[/b]

Zodiac: Aquarius

An officer serving at Acacia Academy, also acts as [url=/c133874]Yui[/url]'s instructor. She holds the rank of Major. Calm and gentle, she always smiles, but her eyes do not share the same expression. She is supportive of her students, and unlike her [i]senpai[/i], she does not say irrational things, so she is adored by the first-year students, however, the second-year students are extremely scared of her for some reason. Even though being an officer, she is also a part of the middle management, and seems to face constant hardship.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://orthrossoft.jp/character/mayumi.html#mayumi]official website[/url]]
